title: Storm Over Metal Shed
description: A beige metal shed with an open carport stands in a lush green field under a dramatic, turbulent sky. Stone pavers lead toward the structure where various tools, equipment and clutter are visible beneath the shelter as lightning flashes in the dark purple and green clouds.
prompt: A lonely beige metal shed with white door and open carport filled with tools and clutter sits in the middle of a bright green grassy field. Stone pavers lead to the building. The sky is filled with massive, dramatic storm clouds in dark purple, black and sickly green hues with visible lightning, creating an ominous atmosphere, realistic digital painting style
